caption: The empty Invoice Maker on zastech.dev: the buttons New, Save, History, Remove branding $9, License / Activate and Print / Save PDF, the line that you can create and save an invoice without an account, and three cards: No account required, A4 PDF unlimited free and Drafts stay on this device. The zastech pricing page: Free forever, $0 always, professional documents with a small zastech footer, no account, no limits, with Unlimited PDF exports, your logo and brand details and drafts saved on your device. The free tools Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder each have a one-time white-label price: $9, $15 and $19.

The PDF Redactor & Sanitizer with a made up two page test invoice: the step Mark sensitive regions says to drag across the preview to create a black redaction, the counter shows 2 redactions and two black boxes lie over the made up e-mail address and phone number of the buyer; the first letter of the word phone sticks out just left of the second box. Document inspection on the right: Pages 2, Metadata fields 7, Attachments 0, JavaScript actions 0, and the original metadata of the file. Buttons Download sanitized PDF (not clicked), Buy unlimited $19 and Trial / License.

The Trial / License window of the PDF Redactor & Sanitizer: Free outputs available, 3 free outputs left, no signup needed, a field for a paid license key, Activate paid license, Buy unlimited $19 and the small print that 3 free sanitized exports need no signup, that free outputs are counted on the server of zastech and that a paid license unlocks unlimited exports on up to 3 browser activations. Nothing was typed or bought.
